task.title: Shaft and Bearing Inspection
task.description: Illustrative inspection training for an unpowered shaft-and-bearing bench assembly.

knowledge_units.action: Rotate the shaft slowly by hand through one full turn
knowledge_units.cue: Illustrative: a visible wobble at the shaft end during rotation
knowledge_units.interpretation: Illustrative: possible misalignment between the shaft and the bearing
knowledge_units.decision: Illustrative: stop and check bearing seating before continuing the inspection

knowledge_units.action: Check that the base mounting fasteners are present

evidence_items.content: Illustrative description of a demonstration segment: the expert inspects the bearing housing.
Illustrative example: if the shaft end wobbles while turning it by hand, I stop and check how the bearing is seated before going further.
Illustrative description of a demonstration segment: the expert checks the base mounting fasteners.

example_expert_responses.answer: Illustrative example: I look at the housing first for grease leaking at the seal or discoloration. Leaking grease suggests the seal or bearing may be damaged, so I do not rotate the shaft until a supervisor has checked it.

fields.cue: Illustrative: grease leaking at the housing seal or discoloration on the housing
fields.interpretation: Illustrative: possible seal or bearing damage
fields.decision: Illustrative: do not rotate the shaft; escalate to a supervisor before continuing

baseline_release.approval_note: Illustrative baseline release seeded for demonstration.
